5 تطلّق , said of a gazelle, He went along, (S, O, Msb, K,) or bounded in his running, or ran briskly in one direction, (اِسْتَنَّ فِى عَدْوِهِ,) and went along, (TA,) not pausing nor waiting for anything; (S, O, Msb, K, TA;) as also ↓ استطلق . (TA.) And تطلّقت الخَيْلُ The horses went [or ran] a heat without restraining themselves, to the goal. (TA.) ―
-b2- And, said of a horse, (tropical:) He staled after running. (AO, O, K.) ―
-b3- Said of the face: see 1, latter half.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
